tailoring.headline: Chef de projet / Product Owner E-Commerce | SAP Commerce Cloud & AI-Assisted Delivery
tailoring.summary: Techno-functional Project Manager and Product Owner with 5+ years of professional experience delivering enterprise web and e-commerce solutions for global groups like Rockwell Automation and Shell. Proven expertise in gathering and analysing business requirements, writing user stories and acceptance criteria, coordinating international technical teams, managing stakeholder relationships, and leveraging generative AI tools in analysis, development, and documentation. SAP Certified Professional.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Chef de projet Web/eCommerce
cover_en.hook: eXalt's commitment to accelerating transformations for major players in luxury, retail, and energy perfectly aligns with my background managing complex digital initiatives. Bringing over 5 years of experience delivering large-scale enterprise e-commerce platforms at global organizations like Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bridge the gap between business and IT to drive high-impact solutions.

bullets.label: Requirements Analysis & Stakeholder Management
bullets.text: Gathered and analysed business requirements directly with international stakeholders and product owners, translating complex business needs into precise user stories, functional specifications, and clear acceptance criteria.

bullets.label: Cross-Functional Project Coordination
bullets.text: Acted as a central coordinator between business and technical teams across global organizations, aligning multi-entity stakeholders and driving end-to-end execution of digital solutions.

bullets.label: AI-Assisted Delivery & Documentation
bullets.text: Extensively leveraged generative AI and LLM tools to accelerate analysis, solution design, technical documentation, and delivery workflows across enterprise projects.

bullets.label: Testing & Quality Assurance
bullets.text: Prepared and executed user acceptance testing (UAT), provided comprehensive functional support, and ensured rigorous quality standards from development through production release.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe with a valid German residence and work permit, I am serving a notice period with my last working day on 15 December 2026, making me available to start on 16 December 2026. I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my techno-functional expertise can support eXalt's clients.

cover_de.subject: Bewerbung als Chef de projet Web/eCommerce
cover_de.hook: eXalts Ansatz, operative Exzellenz mit maßgeschneiderten digitalen Lösungen für namhafte Akteure zu verbinden, fasziniert mich sehr. Mit über fünf Jahren Berufserfahrung in der Steuerung komplexer E-Commerce-Plattformen für globale Konzerne wie Rockwell Automation und Shell bringe ich fundierte Expertise mit, um als transversale Schnittstelle zwischen Business und IT zu agieren.

bullets.label: Anforderungsanalyse & Stakeholder-Management
bullets.text: Ich habe Anforderungen direkt mit internationalen Fachbereichen erhoben, analysiert und in präzise User Stories, funktionale Spezifikationen sowie klare Akzeptanzkriterien übersetzt.

bullets.label: Projektkoordination
bullets.text: Als zentrale Schnittstelle zwischen verschiedenen technischen Teams und Business-Stakeholdern habe ich die bereichsübergreifende Zusammenarbeit und die Umsetzung digitaler Lösungen koordiniert.

bullets.label: KI-gestützte Lieferung
bullets.text: Generative KI- und LLM-Tools setze ich umfassend ein, um Analyseprozesse, Lösungsdesigns und die Projektdokumentation effizient zu beschleunigen.

bullets.label: Qualitätssicherung & Tests
bullets.text: Ich habe Nutzertests (UAT) vorbereitet und durchgeführt, funktionellen Support geleistet und die Entwicklung bis zur erfolgreichen Implementierung begleitet.

cover_de.logistics: Ich wohne in Karlsruhe, verfüge über eine unbeschränkte deutsche Arbeitserlaubnis und befinde mich in einer Kündigungsfrist bis zum 15.12.2026, sodass ich ab dem 16.12.2026 verfügbar bin. Ich freue mich auf ein persönliches Gespräch.

tailoring.why_company: eXalt unites passionate consultants who tackle key digital and industrial challenges for major players in luxury, retail, and energy. I am drawn to eXalt's focus on operational excellence and transverse project leadership, where I can apply my 5+ years of experience bridging business and technical teams on enterprise-scale platforms.
tailoring.motivation_short: Combining 5+ years of enterprise e-commerce project delivery, rigorous requirements engineering, and international stakeholder coordination to drive impactful digital transformations at eXalt.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello! With 5+ years of experience managing enterprise e-commerce platforms, requirements engineering, and coordinating international technical teams at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am very interested in eXalt's digital projects. Let's connect!
tailoring.email_subject: Application: Chef de projet Web/eCommerce – Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my CV and cover letter for the Chef de projet / Product Owner position at eXalt. With over 5 years of experience delivering enterprise web and e-commerce platforms for global groups, I bring deep expertise in requirements engineering, user story creation, and cross-functional team coordination.

I am based in Karlsruhe with a valid work permit and am available starting 16.12.2026 following my notice period.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
